title: EuroTransit / Checkout SLO — Money Path
description: KEEP IN SYNC with EuroTransit-configuration platform/kube-prometheus-stack/dashboards/checkout-slo.configmap.yaml. A local dashboard that measures checkout differently from production is not an accurate rehearsal for production.

panels.title: Checkout success rate (30m) — SLO 99%
panels.description: Confirmed / (confirmed + failed) terminal checkouts. payment_declined and seats_unavailable are business refusals and are excluded (application slo.md).

targets.expr: sum(max by (instance) (rate(orders_checkout_completed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", result="confirmed"}[30m]))) / (sum(max by (instance) (rate(orders_checkout_completed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", result="confirmed"}[30m]))) + sum(max by (instance, reason) (rate(orders_checkout_failed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", reason!~"payment_declined|seats_unavailable"}[30m]))))

panels.title: Confirmed within 2s (30m) — SLO 95%
panels.description: Share of confirmed checkouts whose duration from the accepted payment to confirmation is at most 2 s (orders.checkout.e2e.duration).

targets.expr: sum(max by (instance) (rate(orders_checkout_e2e_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", outcome="confirmed", le="2.0"}[30m]))) / sum(max by (instance) (rate(orders_checkout_e2e_duration_seconds_count{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", outcome="confirmed"}[30m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max by (instance, le) (rate(orders_checkout_e2e_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", outcome="confirmed"}[30m]))))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", method="POST", uri=~"/api/orders"}[5m])))

panels.title: Error budget burn rate (CheckoutFastBurn 14.4×, CheckoutSlowBurn 6×)
panels.description: Failed / terminal checkouts divided by the 1% budget. 1 = spending the budget exactly over 30 days.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (instance, reason) (rate(orders_checkout_failed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", reason!~"payment_declined|seats_unavailable"}[1h]))) / (sum(max by (instance) (rate(orders_checkout_completed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", result="confirmed"}[1h]))) + sum(max by (instance, reason) (rate(orders_checkout_failed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", reason!~"payment_declined|seats_unavailable"}[1h]))))) / 0.01

(sum(max by (instance, reason) (rate(orders_checkout_failed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", reason!~"payment_declined|seats_unavailable"}[6h]))) / (sum(max by (instance) (rate(orders_checkout_completed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", result="confirmed"}[6h]))) + sum(max by (instance, reason) (rate(orders_checkout_failed_total{namespace="eurotransit", app="orders", reason!~"payment_declined|seats_unavailable"}[6h]))))) / 0.01

panels.title: Checkout failures by reason (30m)
panels.description: payment_declined and seats_unavailable are business refusals; they do not consume the error budget.

panels.title: Pipeline delivery duration (orders.checkout.duration, per Kafka delivery, diagnostic)

targets.expr: sum by (consumergroup) (kafka_consumergroup_lag{namespace="eurotransit"}) or sum by (consumergroup) (label_replace(max by (app, topic, partition) (kafka_consumer_fetch_manager_records_lag{namespace="eurotransit"}), "consumergroup", "$1", "app", "(.*)"))
